items.title: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) Stock Looks Fully Valued As Its 64% Run Continues
items.summary: Intercontinental Exchange has ridden a strong three year share price run, and a series of new initiatives, from digital asset custody to tokenized trading, now puts a spotlight on whether that valuation is matched by the returns the business earns on its capital. With the stock recently closing at US$177.81, the key issue is whether investors are paying a price that lines up with the cash the company can generate from each dollar it invests. items.title: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) Could Be 7% Undervalued On Clearing And Data Expansion
items.summary: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) is back in focus after Societe Generale expanded its credit default swap clearing activity on ICE Clear Credit to include single name CDS for clients, underscoring demand for ICE’s risk infrastructure. items.title: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) Plans Tokenized Stock Venue With 113 Assets
items.summary: Intercontinental Exchange (NYSE:ICE) plans to launch a tokenized stock venue offering 113 assets, expanding its digital securities footprint. The new platform brings tokenized versions of traditional equities onto blockchain rails, aimed at institutional and potentially retail participants. This move extends ICE's existing work in digital asset infrastructure into tokenized stocks, alongside its data and technology services business. items.title: 3 Dividend Stocks That Make Money When Wall Street Gets Volatile
items.summary: Most retirees chase calm, but three exchange operators collect a fee on every hedge, option, and futures trade when markets panic. Their payouts look small, yet one dividend comes with a year-end bonus and one carries a risk tied to retail traders.
